[spoiler= [b]A (not so) smooth show[/b]]
[b]A Random Field on the outskirts of Grand Yugorsk[/b]
[i]Two gleaming Xhawk-5 jets sit on the tarmac, being refueled. These are the tören jets, Hydronia's most glamorous aerial technology, reserved for special occasions such as this, Erene's grandest airshow. Piloting the aircraft is Nijaz Yazici and Murat Altug, the best of the best in Hydronia.[/i]

"You ready for this?" says Nijaz as he pats Murat on the back.
"Of course," Murat replies as they complete their signature, complex handshake.
"Then lets go!"
They both climb into their respective jets. The vehicles are black, with shining orange streaks along the sides. On the tail is a large blue star, the symbol of Hydronia and on the nose is the face of an owl, the unforgettable national animal.
"You've got the green light!" shouts a Sikirskian mechanic, giving them the thumbs up. The sound of rumbling fills the air as the engines start up. The jets begin to speed down the runway, slowly lifting off the ground. They begin to gain altitude.
"Lets do this!" they cry in unison.

[b]The skies over Grand Yugorsk[/b]
The crowds assembled below eagerly wait for the next nation's representatives to fly over. A whoosh is heard high up in the sky as the tören jets fly past. The crowd cheers. Another fly-past this time lower. Again... lower. Murat's jets is decending rapidly.
"What the K*hretsin!"
"What's going on there Murat?"
"I.. I dunno! It's outta my control?!"
"Wait a second, the crowd is still cheering, they think it's part of the show!"
"I've regained control, what should I do?"
"Keep going! The crowd is lovin' it!"
Both Jets now turn around for one last low pass. The crowd goes wild as the jets fly less than 4ft above the crowd, then pull upwards.
"Alright, time for the next stage,"
Suddenly, orange and blue smoke begin trailing from the back of their vehicles, as they do loops through the air. The jets begin to change direction rapidly. It appears they are making a shape in the sky, an owl! Hydronia's national animal is painted into the sky using the national colours. A spectacular sight. The planes turn around for one last loop, before turning round and flying back to the field. Overall, a roaring success!
[/spoiler]

(the first five paragraphs are from the I.A Global News factbook.) Arenett Orion-Class warships spotted on Gendarme's national Waters Border. People say that it is a purposeful provoke of the Gendarmite's Military.

Last Monday, (The fifth day of May, 2025) five Orion-Department Arenett warships were sighted doing training exercises while 'lining' Gendarme's territorial waters. The ships of question were four Destroyer-class ships, all the same type, and one Aircraft Carrier.The ships first started their journey on Sunday, and started closing in on the border later that same day. When the ships came back to the island of Kaco Tuesday, there were a few reporters there waiting for an answer.

After hours of getting prepared, the commander of that operation stated: "This is just a routine security check along the water. Due to the rising concerns of a naval invasion, we wanted to secure our waters more than it already is. This should be of no concern, and no warning is to be issued." A few irrelevant questions later, and it goes wild on social media.

The Carmon Naval Bureau (The State's navy government from which the operation was ordered from, and where the ships came from.) Had to address this on Z (formerly Tweet-er) with a warning, stating: Previously states, this was a security check along the border. We also decided to train a regiment of marines on there, because its the productive and obvious thing to do. The practices that were done was formation, fire safety, and repairs. This is nothing out of the usual, since we, as you know, have recently built up our navy and began naval training more, almost always. Further topics about this will be moderated.

Since then it has died out, but with one question: What were they really doing? Gendarme has yet to respond to this.

[i]President Karcson Zoudo has signed a bill that would raise military spending by 10%. This sudden increase of  spending is based on the recent hostility between Gendarme and New Arenenge. The president has also told us that he is working on a special project that will be released shortly. This project will be concerning the New Arenenge Navy and its governed bodies. Another project that the government is working on is the S1ID, or Snake Infantry Destroyer (with the number being the version) This new light tank will hold a stance of a very great anti-infantry, that can even defend itself off against regular tanks. Heres a video from the Minister of Army:

It has come to my attention that the current land vehicles to deal with flat lands either get destroyed, aren't fast enough, or are simply not made for it. With multiple angers, and the weakening of global security, the government has begun to make a change. With this change comes a new vehicle, which is the future of anti-infantry. The S1ID, capable of not just being mass produced, is a very tactical unit that is made for a wide, but not too wide, range of operations. This vehicle is made to dominate flat surfaces, and is the perfect vehicle for pushing through frontlines when the infantry is scared. The vehicle also has multiple seats, that allow transportation to be faster, easier, and can be made to do so at strategic points. The vehicle itself has a two step armour, one layer slows down the bullet, and activates the bomb, then the second layer completely stops everything else. The main gun is a MK44 Bushmaster, which is a very fast firing gun that has a relatively high caliber, and can even shoot small tank rounds. This vehicle has adaptable suspension, meaning it can have a wider range of ground roughness. This vehicle is the next step towards winning this war if it comes.

In central and southern Arenenge, particularly in the states New Texas and Korna, there have been more support for humans, and less support for non-humans. These people believe that humans are the ultimate lifeform, and demote non-humans as Simple creatures that copy the humans actions. This now political party has allegedly been working with the Oceanice Republic, a state notorious for being against non-humans. The Arenett government has not looked into this, because they say the Humans First party is too small and unimportant.

In the water, Arenett warships have been spotted cruising along Gendarmes national water border. The navy government who sent this order our was the state of Carmon Navy. After news reporters rushed to the ships when they came back to the island of Kaco. A week goes by after multiple unanswered questions, and eventually it blows up on social media. Shortly after this, the Carmon Naval Bureau came out with a Tweet on Z (formerly Tweet-er) came out with a warning addressing his a second time. After this, the same people alerted a warning that all talks on the topic of this will be moderated and deleted. There are only a few states where the Carmon laws cant reach, and the topic is still wild. Theorists have come out with conspiracies about the Arenett-Gendarme mega government and their plan to become close to the INNSOC, from George Orwallys 1985 Though these have been disproved due to the rising conflicts between the two nations. This, however, does raise eyebrows as to what the Carmon Naval Bureau was doing, and why they are provoking them. These acts are relatively new, with the last one being in late march. People

On the other side of the Arenett waters, two new additions to the Aren-Union have been added. They are two islands east of Arenenge, named  Numen Island to the north, and Sokoto island to the south. Both have attracted millions of tourists, and 3 national parks to preserve the islands natural and untamed land. The islands themselves are unlike your regular islands in the Arenett Straight. The north island is inhabited by native tribes that fortunately are very nice to civilization. The south island has a mountainous side to the southeast, with impossible to get to land. There is a decently sized national park to keep its beauty. But to the west, it becomes the complete opposite! Perfectly flat and just right for farm land. The center of the island is a large rainforest, which contains one other national park. This island may not have the bigger amount of tourists, but it is still a magnificent place to be.

The southern island has more of a unique landscape, ranging from mountains in the south, toplans in the east, to lowlands and wetlands in the north, to flatlands everywhere else. This island does not have tribes inhabiting it whatsoever.  This island also does not have as big as an area in mountains as the southern one, but surely does have many unique rock formations. One of these rock formations is the Auron roch which means Rock of the Auroras. This rock is a 150 square foot roch with a hole in the top that goes down and completely hollows the rock, even leaving a 5 x 3 ft hole with a bar across. This bar is the star of the rock, being 2 feet thick. Indeed a unique creation in the one hundred year process of erosion.

[spoiler= :D]As the crowd hushed beneath the ink-black sky, the loudspeakers crackled with a deep voice:
[i]And now, from the Second Commonwealth of Jomsland: Prepare for the mighty Rauðvingar Squadron.[/i]
From the western horizon, six sharp silhouettes pierced the air: JFH-Velum MZKF-23 "Sparrowhawk" fighter jets, sleek and angular, their engines howling like warhorns. In flawless delta formation, trailing plumes of dark blue and silver vapor, the colors of Jomsland. Each maneuver, that followed, was a masterclass in control and aggression. The Sparrowhawks danced between tight barrel rolls, high-speed corkscrews, and formation splits executed with blade-sharp accuracy. One pilot performed the infamous Spear-Dive, a near-vertical nosedive from 12,000 feet, only to level out meters above the runway in a deafening sonic burst that shook the crowd to its core. But the show was not over yet.
Suddenly, the Sparrowhawks disappeared into the darkness. Then, a soft mechanical whir echoed overhead. From the opposite end of the runway, hundreds of jomslandic drones rose like a second constellation being born. The Drones shimmered into position, illuminating the sky with icy blue and white lights. Slowly, their formation twisted and reformed: a colossal white dragon, wings unfurled, serpentine body coiling through the night sky.
Then, with a final flourish, the Sparrowhawks re-emerged from the dark above, forming a halo around the luminous dragon. The fighters released trails of sparkling magnesium flares, framing the beast in a burning crown of fire. As the flares died down, the drone-dragon lifted higher, its body dissolving into a blizzard of twinkling motes before vanishing into the stars. The silence was broken by thunderous applause and stunned awe.[/spoiler]
